decision.reason: [ev-a6197708b375] says that "storage overrides for configuring per-broker storage class" are no longer supported and that users should switch to multiple KafkaNodePool resources. It does not name the custom resource kind or the schema field path that holds the overrides, so the subject cannot be pinned down and no exposure condition can be written for applicability. It also leaves the consequence open: it does not say whether existing overrides are rejected or silently ignored. For the details it points to a migration document that is not shown, and none of the surrounding section items mention storage overrides.
